title: Fairs and Festivals — Guntur Taluk, Guntur District, Census of India 1961
publisher: Office of the Registrar General, Census of India
scope: Guntur Taluk historical locality, worship, festival, inscription and oral-history observations recorded in the Guntur Taluk section.
research_note: This source is treated as a historical observation layer. Claims attributed to informants or described as belief/legend are preserved as such and are not silently converted into verified historical facts.
